basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Bhilai (IIT Bhilai) Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 notification has been released for 1 Junior Research Fellow (JRF) vacancy. Eligible candidates are invited to apply through email mode for the IIT Bhilai Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026.

age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 30 years Age relaxation may be given to outstanding candidates or candidates with relevant experience.

qualification.education_qualification: B.E./B.Tech. in ECE/allied branches with minimum 60% marks (or CGPA 6.5) + GATE/UGC-NET Junior Research Fellow/CSIR NET Junior Research Fellow or equivalent + 2 years VLSI experience, M.E./M.Tech. in ECE/allied branches with minimum 60% marks (or CGPA 6.5) + GATE/UGC-NET Junior Research Fellow/CSIR NET Junior Research Fellow or equivalent, Knowledge in semiconductor, solid-state devices, MOS Device Physics, CMOS circuit design, Memory Design, EDA/TCAD, Cadence, Verilog
qualification.details: B.E./B.Tech. in ECE/allied branches with a minimum of 60% marks (or CGPA 6.5) plus GATE/UGC-NET Junior Research Fellow/CSIR NET Junior Research Fellow or equivalent, along with a minimum of two years of relevant VLSI industry/research experience. M.E./M.Tech. in ECE/allied branches with a minimum of 60% marks (or CGPA 6.5) plus GATE/UGC-NET Junior Research Fellow/CSIR NET Junior Research Fellow or equivalent. Knowledge in semiconductor, solid-state devices, MOS Device Physics, CMOS circuit design, Memory Design, EDA/TCAD, Cadence, Verilog is required.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Bhilai Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 08-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Bhilai JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the IIT Bhilai JRF recruitment is 08 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: For the JRF post, candidates need a B.E./B.Tech. or M.E./M.Tech. in ECE or allied branches with at least 60% marks and a valid GATE/UGC-NET JRF/CSIR NET JRF score. Relevant experience is also required for B.E./B.Tech. applicants.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the JRF position is 30 years. Age relaxation may be provided to exceptional candidates or those with significant relevant experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the JRF post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the JRF post will receive a salary of Rs. 37,000/- per month, plus 18% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the IIT Bhilai JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted via email. You need to prepare your application with all necessary details and documents and send it to the official email address specified in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this IIT Bhilai JRF recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the JRF role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the JRF role at IIT Bhilai will primarily involve an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q8. What kind of experience is required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: For candidates with a B.E./B.Tech. degree, a minimum of two years of relevant VLSI industry or research experience is mandatory. M.E./M.Tech. candidates are also required to have a valid JRF qualification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for IIT Bhilai JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section on this page. It is highly recommended to read the notification thoroughly before applying.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The JRF position at IIT Bhilai is a contractual job. The duration and terms of the contract will be as per the institute's policy and the project requirements.
